answers.q1_what_did_you_play: Rummage first, spending the 3 Sparks and drawing three cards; then Rapid Fire for its printed cost of 2; then Duck and Cover.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered replacing Duck and Cover with a drawn 1-energy Attack dealing 7 damage, if Rummage drew one.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 7 potential damage from that alternative in exchange for 5 Block against the telegraphed 11 damage.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. Against a non-damaging intent, I would favor the extra 7-damage Attack over Duck and Cover if Rummage drew one.
